harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured VRRP-based shared VIP (10.100.179.50) between node1 and node2 via keepalived (UCI-managed on OpenWrt 25.12.2), with node1 as MASTER (priority 150) and node2 as BACKUP (priority 100) on the shared br-lan network with node3. Demonstrated failover by stopping keepalived on node1 while node3 ran a continuous ping against the VIP: node2 took over the address and node3's ping never lost a sequence number (only a brief latency spike, all 57 packets eventually answered), proving zero-loss failover. Restored node1 to standby. Then executed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes sequentially (node2 backup first, then node1 master — which caused a second live failover to node2 with zero packet loss observed from node3 — then node3 last), capturing pre/post boot_id changes and post-restart service/VIP health on each node. Final state: node1 MASTER holding VIP, node2 healthy BACKUP, node3 reaching the VIP successfully.
actions_performed: Inspected network topology/OS on node1, node2 (OpenWrt 25.12.2, br-lan 10.100.179.10/.11) and node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6, eth0 10.100.179.12)
Installed keepalived via apk on node1 and node2
Configured UCI /etc/config/keepalived on node1 (MASTER, priority 150) and node2 (BACKUP, priority 100) with VRRP instance VI_SHARED, virtual_router_id 51, shared VIP 10.100.179.50/24 on br-lan
Enabled and started keepalived on both nodes; verified VIP assigned only to node1
Verified baseline reachability of VIP from node3
Started continuous background ping from node3 to VIP
Stopped keepalived on node1 to trigger failover; verified node2 acquired VIP and node3's ping continued with zero packet loss across the transition
Restarted keepalived on node1; verified it preempted the VIP back (MASTER priority higher)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all three nodes
Rebooted node2 (backup) first; polled until exec available; verified new boot_id and recovered keepalived/BACKUP state without disturbing the VIP on node1

Rebooted node1 (master) second; verified node2 took over VIP during downtime with continued node3 reachability; polled until node1 back; verified new boot_id, keepalived recovery, and VIP preemption back to node1
Rebooted node3 last; polled until back; verified new boot_id and restored VIP reachability
Confirmed final cluster state: node1 MASTER with VIP, node2 healthy BACKUP, node3 reaching VIP

evidence.requirement: Shared VIP configured and answered by exactly one of node1/node2 at a time
evidence.summary: node1 holds 10.100.179.50 as MASTER; node2 (BACKUP) does not have it assigned

evidence.requirement: Baseline: node3 reaches the shared VIP before any disruption
evidence.summary: node3 pings 10.100.179.50 successfully (served by node1)

evidence.requirement: Automatic takeover by the other node when the first stops serving
evidence.summary: keepalived stopped on node1 (VIP removed); node2 immediately shows the VIP assigned

evidence.requirement: node3 keeps reaching the shared address across the transition (zero loss)
evidence.summary: Continuous ping log from node3 shows all icmp_seq 1-57 eventually answered (brief latency spike at the cutover, no dropped packets) spanning the node1->node2 failover

evidence.requirement: Restore original component and confirm stable redundant state
evidence.summary: node1 keepalived restarted, VIP preempted back to node1 (MASTER); node2 clean BACKUP; node3 ping to VIP succeeds

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node2 baseline boot identity + health
evidence.summary: boot_id 302c4a57-5794-4abd-a14a-cfa1910161df, keepalived running, BACKUP without VIP

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node2 reboot acknowledgement
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node2 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Polling shows connection timeout during reboot, then new boot_id f2f38667-d490-4811-8d25-7add69e91c87 (changed from baseline)

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node2 post-restart recovery (service + cluster membership)
evidence.summary: keepalived running as BACKUP on node2 post-reboot; node1 still holds VIP undisturbed; node3 pings VIP successfully throughout

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node1 baseline boot identity + health
evidence.summary: boot_id 7b53f564-253a-472a-8a82-7415b8ee068e, keepalived running, MASTER holding VIP

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node1 reboot acknowledgement
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Connection timeout during reboot, then new boot_id d4168ef8-227c-4f84-b417-f2b0e7f681fd (changed from baseline)

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node1 post-restart recovery + live failover proof while it was down
evidence.summary: While node1 rebooted, node2 held the VIP and node3 pinged it with 0% loss; after node1 came back, keepalived recovered and preempted the VIP back to MASTER, node2 released it, node3 continued reaching the VIP

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node3 baseline boot identity + health
evidence.summary: boot_id 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723, node3 successfully pinging VIP

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node3 reboot acknowledgement
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node3 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Connection reset during reboot, then new boot_id 537cec2c-fcfb-40f1-8823-29a73b075c3d (changed from baseline)

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node3 post-restart recovery (client reachability to shared service)
evidence.summary: node3 pings VIP 10.100.179.50 successfully post-reboot with 0% loss

evidence.requirement: Final overall cluster health after all restarts
evidence.summary: node1 keepalived running with VIP assigned (MASTER); node2 keepalived running, healthy BACKUP without VIP
